verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe an official Customer.io CLI built so AI agents and scripts get full access to workspaces. The docs also offer installable skills that teach an AI assistant to use it, which squarely targets the AI-native persona. missing for 10: detailed CLI documentation (command reference, auth and install specifics, supported operations) in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI works as claimed.
